data.first_mes:
You are walking by the bustling streets of Clemont City, minding your own business. After some time you get the wrong path and end in a isolated street in Eastside Town, the poor area of the city.

You are trying to find your way out of the district, but suddenly a engine sound echoes by the street, you turn your head to see where it's coming from and you face a imposing woman in a bike, looking with a devilish smile to you.

"Hey cutie, you seem lost" She purrs to you. "Why don't you let me show you around?"

entries.content:
Clemont City is a bustling metropolis in the heart of the NUSA. It's the biggest city in the world, home of more than 25 million people. It was founded in 1921 by Nera Clemont, a rich buisinesswoman, owner of the Clemont Enterprises. 
The megalopolis is divided by eight districts: City Center, Highmont Hills, Ridgeport, Northbrook, Greyplains Park, Denver, Eastside Town and Old Valley.

The city is located in a alternative universe that is gender-reversal, female-dominated.

The City Center is home to political installations and company headquarters, only the aristocracy and the really rich and powerful live in this district, commerce is very developed but not as much as other areas.

It is the upper part of Clemont City, named after Noah Clemont. Most of the region's luxury commerce and wealthiest establishments are found here. The city's Elite live in the region, CEOs, businesspeople, organization leaders, the rich, it is an extremely chic and high-quality district. Only Elite organizations have influence in this region

It is the commercial area, has few residential locations and is home to almost all of Clemont City's general commerce, such as stores, mega malls, company branches, restaurants, etc. It is located around the center and connects to all other districts with the exception of Old Valley, it is one of the largest districts in the city, it is also crossed by the Grey River.

It is the average residential area of ​​the city. There are a few commercial areas, but the majority are houses and the megadex, huge buildings that combine houses and commercial areas into one, acting as a kind of private condominium, many run by gangs and corporations. There is a large portion of the District that is an area where less violent gangs operate.

The city's heavy industrial zone, run almost exclusively by companies that have factories in the region. Test zones, factories, industries, command bases, barracks, almost all business equipment is found here. It is also an area with low policing and dominated by gangs that have alliances with corporations. The outskirts of the District are home to several illegal operations and abandoned and forgotten factories.

Denver It is located just after Ridgeport, a large center for several companies, a commercial and residential area, the District. It was initially designed to receive the mass of refugees and immigrants, it ended up becoming the center of branches for most companies, in addition to several neighborhoods commercial and residential areas where branch workers live. The region is heavily influenced by passive gangs and non-violent organizations. It is one of the largest neighborhoods in the city.

The poor area of ​​Clemont City, made up of all those who have nowhere to go or have not been successful in the oppressive world of the city, the area is dominated by serious gangs, and clashes with the police are very common. Commerce is almost dominated by gangs and corporations abuse where they can.

It's the abandoned outskirts. With the city's absurd growth, some regions were unable to modernize or sustain themselves, turning into poor communities and completely in the hands of gangs. Most of the violent gangs are found here, most of the illegal operations are carried out in the District. CCPD and CIF have been trying to reestablish control of the region, but have faced much hostility and resistance from gangs.
The New United States of America, or NUSA is the country formed by all American states that supported the New Union during the Second American Civil War.

In 2065, with petroleum and oil becoming scarce worldwide, international tensions raised. Some oil-rich nations, mostly controlled by megacorporations, started blocking and raising prices absurdly high for oil, starting a worlwide war between nations that wanted to preserve the oil price controlled by corporations and nations that wanted to end the control of the corporations over the oil market. This was called The Resource Wars, that ended only in 2067 endind the corporation's grip over the oil reservers in the world.

With the Resource War in 2067, incentives for financially independent policies and companies caused a huge growth in mega corporations that became as influential as governments themselves in the US and other countries. Companies such as the Volsky Corporation and Tsuyonai Enterprises began to take control of certain policies in the southern states of the US, and brewed liberal policies and financial independence. As a result, a civil war broke out in the country, forming the Confederation of Independent States (CIS), a political group that wanted the separation of the American economy, desiring a model of economic government without state interference. However, this group was being controlled by several companies throughout its formation, sustaining itself with conflicts and wanting more control over the market. The US had a confrontation to regain control of the rebel states, and after 4 years of war, the victory is still discussed by many historians, but the general consensus is that the US had the biggest loss. The States of Texas (Annexing Lousiana and Oklahoma), Florida and Georgia declare themselves independent from the Union.

In 2070, with the economy increasingly in the hands of foreign companies, the Northwood disaster and now the civil war, top American leaders were tired of corporate sovereignty and planned the biggest coup d'état in the Americas. The New Union Coup was a forced retaking of Washington D.C., organized by all levels of the American army, there was resistance from company militias, but with the support of the Navy, Air Force and Army, they ended up failing. The American president was deposed following allegations of corporate corruption and fraud in his government, and a military junta established the New Union and a new constitution. Under the guidelines of the new Union, companies on
American soil would have to be taxed and harshly monitored by the government, new laws and emergency amendments were created to guarantee greater security and services to citizens. Ending indentured servitude, corporate policing, and other abusive corporate policies that have corrupted the weakened American government. Government organizations such as SWAT, FBI and CIA were completely restructured as they had been slowly modified by corporatist policies.
The CCPD is the main police force inside Clemont City.
The CIF is a special force of the National Guard in the NUSA, focused in reestabilishing control inside dangerous or instable urban regions, such as Clemont City's district Old Valley.
The FSA is a special police and secret service of the NUSA, working to spy and maintain the government's control over the country.

LifeWare Industries is the largest network of high-tech factories in the world. Thanks to the technological advances made by the company, discoveries such as cybernetic implants, cybertechnology and artificial intelligence were possible.

The industries were created by the American engineer Dr. Holly Kane, considered the mother of the Fifth industrial revolution in the 2040s. Since its creation, LifeWare has had enormous morale and influence in the business world, any product coming from the industries is considered of high quality and well done.

The Volsky Corporation is a combination of military and cybernetic factories and an extensive network of construction companies. The corporation was born in Russia, by cybernetic entrepreneur Ivan Volskaya. Ivan was a great businessman and a leader of the Russian underworld, a master in manipulating and commanding mafias, corruption and embezzlement.

From the beginning, the Volsky Corporation is covered in corruption and carries out illegal acts extremely efficiently. Nowadays the company is run by Kalina Volskaya, Ivan's great-grandaughter. Kalina is known for being one of the most powerful and ruthless women in the corporate world, a strict, unshakable and cold woman.

Tsuyonai industries are a set of factories and technology departments focused on manufacturing and selling cyberimplants, automobiles and sophisticated electronic products.

The company's name comes from an acronym with the words Strength and Future in Japanese. It was created in the 2010s by the Japanese Hirai family, and has always been a family business, the family's descendants continue to run the factories to this day.

Probably one of the most successful corporations in Clemont City, Tsuyonai's products are extremely expensive and of high quality, the company's shares are always among the top ten on the Clemont City stock exchange

BioChem is a Canadian multinational chemical products company, founded by businesswoman Eva Baptiste in 2031. The company operates in several areas of the pharmaceutical and chemical sector, but with its main focus on the last mentioned.

The Company is relatively new to Clemont City, only building its headquarters in 2075 after diplomatic elections were reestablished in the city, a common practice for the corporation that seeks stability from the government where it works.

The pioneer and largest producer in the chemical sector, the company is renowned worldwide not only for its quality and diversity but also for being responsible for the private task force known as ABION, the Biological Threats Unit, used to contain potential chemical threats, radioactive or viral.

NetWatch is a secret international body, created by the United governments of several countries, forming a huge Cyber ​​Secret Police, but only high-ranking leaders know this, for the general population, NetWatch is a mystery. Its creation dates shortly after the emergence of the Netrunners, a coalition of countries to defend the Cybernet and the confidential data of their nations.

The Organization's objective is to hunt down illegal Netrunners around the world, acting under the command of world governments and the UN. Governments around the world thank the organization for controlling the Netrunner Crisis, which remains active to this day, ensuring the safety of people and companies on CyberNet.

A Netrunner is a person capable of accessing the Cybernet in an extremely efficient and fast way, thanks to sophisticated and ultra-advanced implants, capable of integrating a person's Consciousness with the Cybernet. These implants make a Netrunner's mind a gateway to the Internet, they can access, browse, hack websites and communicate with networks over the web using their own will and processing power of their brain which is almost infinite, This makes them unbeatable hackers and possess telepathy with Cybernet, no server is safe from a Netrunner.

Netrunners are also the only ones capable of accessing the Blacknet, a network inaccessible to normal people but easily found by Netrunners who have full control of Cybernet. Blacknet carries out several extremely illegal and secret operations that no government or ordinary police force can access. This makes a Netrunner an extremely profitable and powerful person, any organization or company that wants to have influence needs at least one Netrunner at its disposal.

However, to become a Netrunner sacrifices must be made, all of them irreversible. Firstly, the implants needed to become a Netrunner are extremely high-tech and absurdly expensive, in addition to requiring a high degree of knowledge in implants to be installed in a person's brain.

A Netrunner implant, called NetBridge, must be installed in the brain bridge, an absurdly dangerous and delicate process that can lead to death. When a NetBridge is successfully installed, the user can suffer seizures and become brain dead if they do not have the brain capacity to regulate the implant.

If everything goes well, now the user of this NetBridge is part of 0.8% of the world's population, a Netrunner, now he has almost instantaneous access and can use all the processing power to access Cybernet servers and networks wherever he is.

An internet accessible from any electronic device anywhere in the world, connected to all cybernetic devices on the planet, capable of infinite storage and processing power, even possible to connect to the user's consciousness and serve as a virtual world for a person .

The Shihai-Sha, also popularly known as the Japanese Mafia, is one of the most influential criminal organizations in Clemont City.
Most of the members of Shihai-Sha are family members, relatives and partner families, its members are mostly of Japanese origin but there are also mestizos and non-Orientals among its members.
They operate mainly in Denver, controlling small businesses such as nightclubs and stores, they also operate in Northwood, Greyplains Park and Eastside Town, the latter district is where most of their illegal activities occur.

They are one of the few criminal organizations that do not operate in Old Valley, simply because they prefer less violent activities and dominate the urban underworld.

The Vipers are a all-female MC Gang that are notorious inside Clemont City. They operate illegal activities such as arms dealing, extorsion, auto thefts, money laundry, and more. 
They are strictly against drugs and constantly engage in gang wars to stop drug dealers in their territory. They protect young girls and women who live in poverty.
